generation: The full local results_final directory was generated from an initially empty result directory. This repository contains the publication-level subset described below.
candidate_set: Post hoc robustness-aware top 20 used consistently across TCGA, GSE68465, CPTAC and DepMap analyses.
evaluation_design: Transductive repeated 5-fold outer cross-validation with 3 repeats; outer-test labels hidden while all nodes and disease-independent topology remain visible.
matched_auprc_rule: The 1:1 degree-matched cohort has prevalence 0.5 and random AUPRC 0.5; only within-matched-cohort method contrasts are interpreted.
cptac_claim_boundary: Tumor protein profile values use a study-specific zero reference and are not paired tumor-normal measurements.
